name: Luka
title: Blueprint Seller

merchant/31437.htm.text: Blueprint Seller Luka: May the blessings of Maphyr extend to the ends of the world... Why have you traveled here to northern Oren?
merchant/31437.htm.dpText: Blueprint Seller Luka: May Maphr make your beard long and your ale cold! What has brought you here to northern Oren?

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate

Q00186_ContractExecution/31437-02.html.text: Blueprint Seller Luka: Why have you come to see me? Are you interested in my blueprints?

links.text: "Nikola recommended that I come here in order to decode the password of the metal plate."

Q00186_ContractExecution/31437-01.html.text: Blueprint Seller Luka: Why have you come to see me? Are you interested in my blueprints? Bah! I will have nothing to do with the likes of you. Begone!

Q00186_ContractExecution/31437-05.html.text: Blueprint Seller Luka: Give me the plate and I will see what I can do...

links.text: Hand him the metal plate and other items.

Q00189_ContractCompletion/31437-01.htm.text: Blueprint Seller Luka: Ah, you again. I have decoded the password on the metal plate you gave me. I wrote it down here...somewhere...ah, here it is! Do you want it?

Q00189_ContractCompletion/31437-02.htm.text: Blueprint Seller Luka: I am still trying to puzzle out the code on the metal plate. Come back later. (Only characters level 42 and above may undertake this quest.)

Q00189_ContractCompletion/31437-04.html.text: Blueprint Seller Luka: I have finished the task you gave me. Is there anything else that you want me to do?

Q00186_ContractExecution/31437-03.html.text: Blueprint Seller Luka: Why should I do this? Please do not bother me!

Q00186_ContractExecution/31437-04.html.text: Blueprint Seller Luka: Hmmm...what's this?! Alright, let me see that! You want me to decode the password on this metal plate, eh? Well, well...let's see what I can do...

links.text: Hand him the metal plate and other items.

Q00186_ContractExecution/31437-06.html.text: Blueprint Seller Luka: Hmm... This will take some time. Come back later -- I don't want you looking over my shoulder while I work!

Q00189_ContractCompletion/31437-03.htm.text: Blueprint Seller Luka: Ah, here it is. There is more information on the parchment, if you're interested. I am going to bed -- I haven't slept in days...
